# spo-msedge.net
> Microsoft Edge enterprise and service delivery domain used for Edge update, policy, support, and deployment resources.

This domain is associated with Microsoft Edge distribution and enterprise management workflows. The most useful LLM-facing context comes from Microsoft Edge documentation, policy references, deployment guidance, update channels, and support resources used alongside Edge service endpoints.

## Microsoft Edge Documentation
- [Microsoft Edge documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/): Central documentation hub for deploying, configuring, and managing Microsoft Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business): Overview of Edge business features, security, and enterprise management capabilities.
- [Microsoft Edge Enterprise landing page](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download): Business-focused download and deployment entry point for Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge support](https://support.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge): End-user and admin support articles for Microsoft Edge features and troubleshooting.

## Deployment and Installation
- [Download Microsoft Edge for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download): Download installers for supported Edge channels and platforms.
- [Deploy Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/deploy-edge): Guidance for enterprise rollout of Microsoft Edge across managed environments.
- [Configure Microsoft Edge update settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-update-policies): Policy-based configuration for Edge Update behavior in organizations.
- [Microsoft Edge update overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-update-overview): Explains Edge update architecture, servicing, and channel behavior.
- [Manage Microsoft Edge on Windows](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies): Entry point for Windows management and policy configuration.

## Policies and Configuration
- [Microsoft Edge Browser Policy Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies): Complete reference for Microsoft Edge browser policies.
- [Microsoft Edge Update Policy Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-update-policies): Reference for policies controlling Edge Update installation and servicing.
- [Configure Microsoft Edge policy settings on Windows](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/configure-microsoft-edge): How to apply and manage Edge policies in Windows environments.
- [Configure Microsoft Edge using mobile device management](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/configure-edge-with-mdm): Manage Edge settings through MDM providers such as Intune.
- [Security baseline for Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-security-baseline): Recommended enterprise security configuration baseline for Edge.

## Update Channels and Servicing
- [Microsoft Edge release schedule](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-release-schedule): Planned release cadence for Stable, Beta, Dev, and Extended Stable channels.
- [Microsoft Edge channels overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-channels): Describes Edge channels and intended deployment scenarios.
- [Microsoft Edge Stable Channel](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download?form=MA13FJ): Stable channel download for production deployments.
- [Microsoft Edge Beta Channel](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download?form=MA13FJ): Beta channel download for pre-release validation and testing.
- [Microsoft Edge Dev Channel](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/download/insider): Dev and Insider builds for evaluation and early feature testing.
- [Microsoft Edge release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-stable-channel): Release notes for Stable channel versions and fixes.

## Security and Identity
- [Microsoft Edge security documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-security): Security capabilities and enterprise protection features in Edge.
- [Microsoft Defender SmartScreen in Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-security-smartscreen): Guidance for SmartScreen protection and related policy controls.
- [Microsoft Edge password manager security](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-security-password-manager-security): Security considerations for password storage and autofill in Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge and Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-security-identity): Identity integration and enterprise sign-in behavior for Edge.
- [Conditional Access in Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/ms-edge-security-conditional-access): Using Conditional Access and device trust with Edge.

## Management and Administration
- [Manage Microsoft Edge with Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/mem/intune/apps/manage-microsoft-edge): Intune-based management of Edge app settings and policies.
- [Administrative template files for Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/configure-microsoft-edge#configure-policies-on-windows): Use ADMX templates to configure Edge in Active Directory environments.
- [Microsoft Edge management service](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-service): Cloud-based management service for configuring Edge policies.
- [Configure kiosk mode in Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-configure-kiosk-mode): Set up and manage kiosk experiences with Edge.
- [Configure site lists for Internet Explorer mode](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/edge-ie-mode-site-list-manager): Manage Enterprise Mode site lists for IE mode compatibility.

## Developer and Web Platform Resources
- [Microsoft Edge developer documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/): Documentation for building, testing, and optimizing web experiences in Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge WebView2 documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/): Embed web content in native applications using WebView2.
- [Microsoft Edge DevTools documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/devtools-guide-chromium/): Reference and guides for debugging and performance analysis tools.
- [Microsoft Edge extensions documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/): Build, publish, and manage browser extensions for Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge Insider](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/download/insider): Insider channels and preview builds for developers and testers.

## Troubleshooting and Support
- [Troubleshoot Microsoft Edge installation and updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-troubleshoot): Common deployment, installation, and update troubleshooting guidance.
- [Microsoft Edge support hub](https://support.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge): Official support articles for Edge setup, sync, privacy, and browsing issues.
- [Microsoft 365 admin support](https://admin.microsoft.com/Adminportal/Home#/support): Admin support entry point for Microsoft-managed enterprise services.
- [Microsoft Edge Insider support](https://www.microsoftedgeinsider.com/support): Support resources for Insider builds and preview channels.
- [Microsoft Q&A for Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/answers/tags/255/microsoft-edge): Community and Microsoft-moderated technical questions about Edge.

## Release Notes and Lifecycle
- [Microsoft Edge Stable Channel release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-stable-channel): Version-by-version Stable channel changes, fixes, and security updates.
- [Microsoft Edge Extended Stable release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-extended-stable-channel): Release notes for Extended Stable enterprise servicing builds.
- [Microsoft Edge Beta Channel release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-beta-channel): Beta channel changes for pre-production validation.
- [Microsoft Edge Dev Channel release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-dev-channel): Dev channel updates and feature changes for early adopters.
- [Microsoft Edge lifecycle FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/lifecycle/products/microsoft-edge): Product lifecycle information for Microsoft Edge support and servicing.
